text:
and the bodhisattvas who will attain enlightenment.
All of them are here.
I could not describe them all in words.
Therefore, you should practice them here.
If you do not delight in the Dharma of the Omniscient One,
you will regret it in the future.
All the perfections I have taught,
and all the paths of wisdom and the ocean of wisdom,
are not to be known by those who are childish and who rely on the body.
In the future, when the world is degenerate, when beings are evil,
when the Dharma is in decline and the lower realms are increasing,
the wise will be very discouraged,
and will be frightened like deer.
The bodhisattva who is the king of supreme joy,
who has practiced the six perfections for a thousand eons,
